Release note: 

<!-- Aim for one phrase, past tense, naming what the user sees, with no
link: the release adds it. A second sentence only when one phrase
cannot name the change; no semicolon, and no description of the new
behavior. The title's type picks the section and its first word:
`feat`: `Added`; `perf`, `refactor` or a user-visible `chore(deps)`:
`Improved`, `Reduced`, `Changed`, `Removed` or `Updated`; `fix` or `bug`:
`Fixed`. Internal work: `Release note: none`. A batch writes one line per
closed issue, each ending `(#NN)`. Only a `release` pull request, or one
scoped `changelog` that corrects released sections, edits CHANGELOG.md. -->
